power.scope: Coach figures are inherited thermal/COP sensitivities, including 4.32 kW auxiliary allocation, not measured appliance loads. No electric brake compressor is included; mechanical compressor must be budgeted on the traction engine. Margins assume the required output is available at installation conditions, before starting demand and added tender electrical loads. Catalog-to-installed derating must be resolved by the supplier.

mass.excluded: Tender frame, body, lining, running gear, new mounts/ducts/exhaust, mechanical compressor/drive/treatment, electrical equipment, batteries and unreconciled longer fluid lines. No installed CG or axle/spring rating implied.

fuel.note: Both engines draw from the same retained fuel allowance. Separate approved pickups/returns, isolation and venting need design; traction consumption and usable fuel are unknown.
